summary: The counterexample is valid for every integer k >= 1 and every nonempty prefix, including every choice of global minimizing rate. The scalar definitions and their normalization agree with the accepted predecessor, and only its applicable one-coordinate identities and bounds are imported. The proof correctly excludes both endpoint rates, derives the uniform radius and imbalance bounds at every remaining minimizer, proves the strict surplus estimate with constant 586/5, and places all active heights above T/2. The disjoint original-support sectors establish Z/Z_bin >= 1 + k/12. No mathematical error or gap was found.
